scripts.dev:mock: cp -n packages/adapter-api/.env.mock packages/adapter-api/.env 2>/dev/null; concurrently -k -n mock,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter mock-api dev" "sleep 2 && pnpm --filter abako-adapter start:dev"
scripts.test:mock: rm -f packages/mock-api/data/mock-registry.sqlite && concurrently -k -s first -n mock,test -c blue,yellow "pnpm --filter mock-api start" "sleep 2 && cd packages/adapter-api && SQLITE_PATH=:memory: USE_MOCK_AUTH=true SIGNING_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4010 FEDERATE_SERVER=http://localhost:4010/api BRAMP_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4010 pnpm exec jest --config ./jest.config.js --runInBand --forceExit"
